description: This Java source file defines the OrganisationCurrencyRepositoryWrapper class, which provides a wrapper around the OrganisationCurrencyRepository. Its purpose is to retrieve OrganisationCurrency entities by currency code and throw a specific exception if the entity is not found. The class is marked as a Spring @Service component, indicating it is a service-layer component within the application.
